description: Cement kiln dust, item 307(B). One occurrence, 1,091 tons. A cementitious byproduct, not slag cement.
sourceTitle: Item Price History, June 1, 2021 to November 30, 2022
note: Statewide roll-up in the Oklahoma DOT item price history for lettings from 2021-06-01 through 2022-11-30. Average awarded price. Pavement concrete is bid separate from placement. A thin item is still the published roll-up; the occurrence count is in the description.

description: Unit value calculated from printed sales quantity and value, 2017. Both were estimated by USGS.
sourceTitle: Minerals Yearbook 2021, Iron and Steel Slag, Table 1
note: Calculated here as value divided by quantity. The table prints thousand metric tons and thousand dollars, so the ratio is dollars per metric ton. USGS marks the sales figures estimated. This is not a printed unit-value cell. Granulated slag is the feedstock for slag cement; the table does not price ground granulated slag separately.
